fields.Name: T128 - AI Configuration Detail Panel and View Toggle
fields.Description: Tests system-configuration's grid/list view toggle combined with its selectedConfig detail panel (onOpenConfiguration/closeDetail) - the config section's own dual-surface UX, distinct from card expansion and from other sections' panels.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Configuration section. First switch the view toggle from Grid to List (and back), then click an 'Open' / open-configuration action on a configuration to open its detail panel. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the view toggle switches the layout between card grid and table, AND opening a configuration surfaces a detail panel showing its status, description, and stats. Seeing the detail panel render is success. A valid empty state (no configurations) also counts.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Grid/List view toggle switches the configuration layout between cards and a table
Triggering the open/details action on a configuration opens a detail panel with its status/description/stats (or a valid empty state is shown)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
